name.ja: MG 1/100 ダブルオークアンタフルセイバー

description.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム 00V戦記」に登場するダブルオークアンタのバリエーション機体がMGに登場！
description.en: A variation of the 000 Qanta that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam 00V Senki" is now available in MG!

description.ja: • 本体形状が忠実に再現され、多彩な機構を備えた武装「GNソードIVフルセイバー」は新規パーツで再現！
description.en: • The body shape is faithfully reproduced, and the armed "GN Sword IV Full Saber" equipped with a variety of mechanisms is reproduced with new parts!

description.ja: • GNコンデンサを搭載し、GNソードIVとの接続部分を備えた背面部と、海老川兼武氏の描いたビジュアルをイメージした頭部アンテナは新規造形！
description.en: • The back part, which is equipped with a GN capacitor and has a connection part with the GN Sword IV, and the head antenna, which is based on the visual drawn by Kanetake Ebikawa, are newly designed!

description.ja: • GNソードIVフルセイバー用のマーキングを含むマーキングシール、GNソードIV用台座が付属！
description.en: • MarkingSeal including marking for GN Sword IV Full Saber and pedestal for GN Sword IV are included!

accessories.ja: 武装用ディスプレイベース×1
